author.name: KinderESL Teaching Team
author.shortBio: Educational materials created for preschool, kindergarten, and early ESL classrooms with a focus on handwriting readiness, phonics, and early math.
author.fullBio: KinderESL resources are created for early childhood teachers and homeschooling parents. The worksheets focus on simple, high-contrast layouts, handwriting stroke directionality, and clear learning milestones for young learners.
